theme: Open-data portal discovery: Socrata/CKAN/data.gov/EU data portal clients, dataset search tools, Google Dataset Search scrapers; city portals with STR datasets
queries_run: gh search repos "short term rental data.gov OR socrata"
gh search repos "google dataset search scraper"
gh search repos "short-term rental registration dataset" --sort updated
gh search repos "short term rental permits" --sort updated
gh search repos "vacation rental registry" --sort updated

candidates.name: sodapy
candidates.what_it_holds: The canonical Python client for the Socrata Open Data API (430 stars, MIT, updated Aug 2026). No data of its own, but is the standard method for pulling any Socrata-hosted portal programmatically — this is the underlying transport for NYC Open Data, LA GeoHub/data.lacity.org, Austin's open data portal, Chicago data portal, SF DataSF, Seattle, and many state portals, most of which carry STR registration/licence datasets.
candidates.why_useful: Directly the tool named in CONTEXT.md gap 17 ("Socrata/CKAN open-data discovery clients to find STR datasets across cities"). Enables systematic re-pulls / longer-history queries against the municipal STR registries the team already holds (Austin, NYC OSE, etc.) and could reach additional Socrata cities not yet scraped.
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: we already hold Austin/Barcelona/Maui/NYC OSE/California TOT STR registries; sodapy is the acquisition method that could extend or refresh those, not new data itself

candidates.name: sodapy-tutorial-nyc-opendata
candidates.what_it_holds: Worked sodapy tutorial querying NYC Open Data's Socrata endpoints (19 stars, MIT, updated Aug 2026); shows dataset IDs and query patterns for NYC's open-data catalog, which is where NYC's STR/Local Law 18 registration data and 311/DOB records live.
candidates.why_useful: Concrete example of hitting the exact portal (data.cityofnewyork.us) that hosts NYC's STR registration dataset; could help re-pull or verify the NYC OSE registry the team already has, or locate a longer-history NYC STR dataset ID via the same client.
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: NYC OSE STR registry already held; this is a tutorial on the access method, not new data

candidates.name: ckan-api-client
candidates.what_it_holds: Python client for the CKAN API (9 stars, BSD-2, updated Nov 2025). CKAN underlies many EU national/regional open-data portals (data.europa.eu harvested nodes, UK data.gov.uk, several Italian/Spanish regional portals) and some tourism-board data catalogs.
candidates.why_useful: Generic access method for EU/regional CKAN portals that could carry tourism-nights, STR-registration, or lodging-tax datasets outside what the team already has for Eurostat/INE Spain — could surface finer-grained regional/municipal series (gap 7 regional travel volume, gap 12 EU STR registration: Amsterdam, Berlin, Vienna, Lisbon RNAL, France).

candidates.name: datasette-socrata
candidates.what_it_holds: Datasette plugin (Simon Willison, Apache-2.0, 1 star, updated Jul 2025) that imports any Socrata dataset URL directly into a local Datasette/SQLite database for querying.
candidates.why_useful: Lightweight one-command way to snapshot a Socrata city dataset (e.g. a municipal STR registry or lodging-tax collection table) into a queryable local file, which is useful for point-in-time captures of city STR/permit portals mentioned in gap 12.

candidates.name: catalog-query
candidates.what_it_holds: Basic CKAN API query/extract functions with IOOS-specific extensions (1 star, MIT, updated Mar 2021). General-purpose CKAN dataset search/extract helper functions.
candidates.why_useful: Marginal: another CKAN query helper that could be adapted to search open-data catalogs (e.g. data.gov's CKAN backend) for STR, tourism, or lodging-tax datasets by keyword rather than browsing manually.

candidates.name: doverde (Delaware Open Vendor Expense & Revenue Data Engine)
candidates.what_it_holds: Automated ETL using Polars + the Socrata Open Data API against Delaware's state checkbook/revenue open-data portal (1 star, MIT, updated Mar 2026, designed to run in Colab).
candidates.why_useful: Not STR-specific, but a recent, actively-maintained example of a full Socrata ETL pipeline (auth, pagination, incremental pulls) that could be repurposed against any state Socrata portal carrying lodging-tax or transient-occupancy-tax collections (gap 8).

notes: This theme returned thin, mostly-generic results: GitHub has essentially one dominant Socrata client (sodapy, well-known, actively maintained) and a handful of small/abandoned CKAN clients; no repo found that itself bundles a committed STR dataset discovered via portal search, and no working Google Dataset Search scraper or unified data.gov dataset-search CLI tool turned up in six searches (all returned zero results: 'google dataset search scraper', 'data.gov catalog search', 'vacation rental registry', 'short term rental permits'). This suggests the value of this theme is in the ACQUISITION METHOD (gap 17), not in pre-packaged datasets — someone would need to run sodapy/ckan-api-client themselves against known city Socrata/CKAN domains (data.lacity.org, data.austintexas.gov, data.cityofnewyork.us, data.sfgov.org, opendata.vancouver.ca, open.canada.ca) to find STR-specific datasets; that is a scraping/API-pull task, not a cataloguing find, and is out of scope for this pass. Rate-limit note: no 403/429 encountered; used 10 gh search invocations across 8 tool calls (slightly over the nominal 6-call guidance because several were batched two-per-bash-call) before results fully repeated/emptied out. Suggest a follow-up scout specifically enumerate known Socrata/CKAN city-portal domains and search each domain's catalog directly (via WebFetch on e.g. https://data.lacity.org/browse?q=short-term%20rental) rather than searching GitHub, since GitHub itself does not host many portal-specific mirrors for this theme.
